name_zh: 叙利亚·阿萨德：阿拉维内战与化武俄伊朗生存
name_en: Syria Assad: Alawi Civil War & Chemical Weapons Russia Iran Survival
description_zh: 巴沙尔·阿萨德 (1965-) 叙利亚总统 (2000-)，阿拉维派少数统治逊尼多数，2011阿拉伯春天演变内战，化武指控/俄伊军事介入/伊斯兰国崛起/难民海啸，以毁灭性代价维持政权生存。
description_en: Bashar al-Assad (1965-) Syria President (2000-), Alawi minority ruling Sunni majority, 2011 Arab Spring evolved civil war, chemical weapons accusations/Russia Iran military intervention/ISIS rise/refugee tsunami, maintained regime survival at catastrophic cost.
reason_zh: 阿萨德代表少数派统治如何通过暴力镇压与外部大国庇护在内战中生存，展示了化武红线如何在大国博弈中被模糊化处理，其生存代价是叙利亚国家半毁灭与百万难民。
reason_en: Assad represents how minority rule survives civil war through violent suppression and external great power patronage, demonstrating how chemical weapons red line gets blurred in great power competition, his survival cost is Syria half-destruction and million refugees.
steps_zh: 研究阿萨德早年伦敦眼科医生与兄长巴塞勒意外去世继位
分析2011德拉抗议演变全国内战与自由军崛起
探讨2013古塔化武攻击与俄伊军事介入转折
评估伊斯兰国崛起与库尔德自治/土耳其干预/难民危机
总结阿拉维内战化武俄伊朗生存对叙利亚国家与地区秩序的毁灭性重塑
steps_en: Study Assad early London ophthalmologist and brother Bassel accidental death succession
Analyze 2011 Daraa protests evolved national civil war and FSA rise
Explore 2013 Ghouta chemical attack and Russia Iran military intervention turning point
Evaluate ISIS rise and Kurdish autonomy/Turkish intervention/refugee crisis
Summarize Alawi civil war chemical weapons Russia Iran survival destructive reshaping of Syria state and regional order
expected_zh: 理解少数派政权如何通过大国庇护在内战中生存，掌握化武红线在大国博弈中失效的机制，评估叙利亚重建的不可能性与地区地缘政治的永久性改变。
expected_en: Understand how minority regime survives civil war through great power patronage, grasp chemical weapons red line failure mechanism in great power competition, evaluate Syria reconstruction impossibility and regional geopolitics permanent alteration.
case_zh: 2000 总统；2011 春天；2013 化武；俄伊介入；持续。阿拉维内战化武俄伊朗生存范式永存。
case_en: 2000 President; 2011 Spring; 2013 chemical weapons; Russia Iran intervention; ongoing. Alawi civil war chemical weapons Russia Iran survival paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Alawi Authoritarianism / Civil War Survival / Great Power Proxy
cross_cultural_impact: Civil war; chemical weapons; Russia/Iran proxy; refugee crisis; state destruction
